text:
carmen: FYI I'm kicking off a focused RBAC + KMS resync dry-run in staging today 14:00 PT. Purpose: validate new owner-lookup heuristics, exercise grant revoke/create paths, and confirm audit-log continuity before widening scope.

aldo: Thanks for the heads-up. What's the canary footprint and explicit abort criteria?

carmen: Canary: auth-proxy, payments-worker, flag-evaluator. Abort if any service sees >0.3% 401 rate for sustained 3m, or if audit-playback reports missing kms grant ops in the window. Also abort if >2 pods crash in 5m.

ops-bot: creating immutable snapshot for this run. artifact: s3://redwood-sec-dryruns/4288881234-snap.tar.gz. snapshot id: snap-4288881234.

carmen: Owner-lookup note: new heuristic order is owner tag -> onboarding ticket -> last-auth within 150 days. Mark ambiguous roles to review queue instead of auto-removal. We'll exclude any roles or keys with external-account grantees.

aldo: Good. For KMS, prefer testing grants only (no CMK rotation). Please paste the exact commands you'll run so infra can tail logs.

carmen: KMS commands (staging test key alias/stg-sync-key):
```
# revoke grant
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/stg-sync-key --grant-id grant-7e6f
# create grant
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/stg-sync-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/stg-sync-role --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```

sec-bot: preflight export complete. checksum: sha256:3a7bd3e2360a3d6249d5b8b9d1f1b3a9. Export path: s3://redwood-sec-dryruns/export-4288881234.tar.gz

sre-oncall: I'll monitor token refresh errors, restart counts, and latency. Alert thresholds: token err >0.3% sustained 3m, restarts >2 in 5m. Post any anomalies here.

carmen: Running canary now. I'll post diffs and audit-proxy traces. Please react with :eyes: if you are watching.

aldo: :eyes: tracking payments-worker traces and CloudTrail
sre-oncall: watching infra metrics

ops-bot: KMS-step initiated. tracking id kms-op-428888-A.

carmen: Canary complete. Observations: payments-worker had 2 brief 401 spikes (0.28% peak) during revoke window, both resolved after reapply + 1 restart. auth-proxy unaffected. audit-proxy + CloudTrail show RevokeGrant and CreateGrant events present and correlated for alias/stg-sync-key. No gaps found in primary stream.

aldo: Any keys with cross-account grants flagged?
carmen: Yes, we skipped 3 keys that had external grantees; they are in the manual review list.

sre-oncall: infra notes: token refresh spike coincided with revoke window, recovered within 45s. No pod flapping.

carmen: Next steps: schedule three weekly staging passes with gradually increasing canary size, then propose a staggered prod rollout in 15m windows. I'll open RFC-SEC-614 and attach logs + the rollback playbook.

aldo: Please add a short blameless FYI for support mentioning transient 401s and expected recovery action (recreate grant + restart).
carmen: Will do. Thanks all for watching.
